title: Procurement tipping points & continuous landscape probe
creator: Priya Patel
description:
Objective: Build an evidence-backed playbook that maps vendor/model procurement tipping points (cost/latency/availability) to recommended actions for Hosted/Dedicated/Private customers, and run a continuous probe that tracks vendor signals across regions.

Background: We have a large backlog of ad-hoc market questions from Sales and Solutions about when to recommend Reserved (Dedicated) vs Hosted vs Private deployments for different customer profiles. Meanwhile the open-model landscape is moving fast: new quantized variants, regional availability differences, and hardware-specific performance profiles. This ticket centralizes a repeatable research + scoring flow and delivers a near-real-time dashboard + decision triggers.

Scope:
- Define procurement "tipping points" (thresholds) for recommendations (e.g., sustained cost delta >X%, p95 latency >Y ms, outage frequency >Z per week).
- Create a vendor-signal taxonomy (availability, latency, price, quantization fidelity, license risk, regional presence).
- Build a scoring rubric and automated pipeline to surface candidates for escalation to Sales/AE and Eng procurement.
- Deliver a lightweight dashboard for PM/SEs and a one-pager playbook for GTM.
- Run a 4-week probe focused on NA + APAC RAG/embedding workloads and capture signal drift patterns.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Scoring rubric documented and approved by PM+Solutions (Confluence).
2) Automated pipeline (ETL job) pulling availability/price/latency daily into REDWOOD_ANALYTICS dataset.
3) Dashboard with filters for region, workload (chat/embeddings/rerank), and recommended action visible to Sales.
4) Example playbook: 3 customer archetypes with explicit triggers and next-step templates.
5) Probe run results (4 weeks) in a summary report with recommended thresholds and a list of 5 high-risk model vendors for procurement follow-up.
deliverables: Google Drive: Probe data export (CSV) and analysis notebook
research_plan:
Phase 1 (Week 1): Desk research and stakeholder interviews (Sales, Solutions, Infra procurement).
Phase 2 (Weeks 1–2): Define taxonomy + rubric; pilot ETL to ingest public vendor price lists, latency microbenchmarks (internal), and outage feeds.
Phase 3 (Weeks 2–5): Run continuous probe for 4 weeks across NA/APAC; capture distributional shifts and compute tipping events.
Phase 4 (Week 6): Synthesize into playbook + runbook and handoff to Sales ops and Eng procurement.

Methods: combine synthetic microbenchmarks (short RPS-driven tests), public price scraping, partner portal price pulls, customer-reported incidents, and model behavior probes (quality regression sampling). Prioritize reproducibility and observable signals over raw model scoring at this stage.
